description: Distribution (min/p10/q1/median/q3/p90/max, std dev, histogram, nearest hospital per percentile) of one figure per hospital for a code, never blending billing classes. Exactly one shape is accepted: all_terms=true with no filter, or all_terms omitted with a filter naming billing_class, methodology and setting (use *_UNSPECIFIED for 'not filed'). Counterpart to get_code_price_distribution. Backed by the hospital-prices serving snapshot; fails with UNAVAILABLE until the server has opened one.

all_terms.description: Each hospital's all-terms figure. Cannot be combined with filter.

code_type.description: Code system the billing code belongs to, e.g. APR-DRG, CDM, CPT, HCPCS, MS-DRG, RC.

filter.description: Restricts which price terms are returned. Each field left out matches any value; set a field (even to its *_UNSPECIFIED value, which means 'not filed') to require it. Billing classes are never blended: a facility fee and a professional fee are separate bills.

min_sample_count.description: Only hospitals backed by at least this many billing records. Negative values are rejected.

reference_price.description: When positive, hospitals_below_reference counts hospitals priced strictly below it.

statistic.description: Which per-hospital figure to distribute (default average).

name: get_code_provider_price_distribution
title: Get provider price distribution for a code
